central_hdmac.qemu_summary: Eight channels; DMAC_EN gating, reset EMPTY/CFG state, asynchronous transfers, full 16-bit BTSIZE, 8/16/32-bit width conversion (including the 11b WORD alias), increment/decrement/fixed and SPIP/DPIP Picture-in-Picture addressing, suspend/resume, SREQ/CREQ/LAST software handshakes, fixed/round-robin one-transaction arbitration with a migrated cursor, non-descriptor AUTO replay/contiguous buffers with REP reload and STALLED/KEEPON, descriptor-coupled AUTO rows 7/8 with initial BTSIZE replay, linked-list live-state loading and mutation across page boundaries, selective source/destination reload, Row-1 disabled-next termination, any-cycle graph parking, stop-on-DONE and CTRLA DONE writeback, AHB error status with partial residue plus read-only/peripheral/writeback aborts, and migration of partial FIFO/request/PiP/replay/pending-IRQ state. Hardware handshakes are chunk-scoped and level-sampled: one request edge grants one SCSIZE/DCSIZE chunk, source and destination requests pace their sides independently through the conversion FIFO, arming a channel samples the live request level rather than banked edges (the at_hdmac-shaped acmd13-completion qtest holds the Linux SD regression), and a banked edge is forgotten when its last armed consumer is disabled. Concurrently pending unpaced channels interleave at chunk granularity under both GCFG.ARB_CFG modes, and descriptor-versus-transaction length mismatches resolve deterministically with driver-shaped STOP/CHDR recovery. Beat granularity inside a chunk, FIFO_CFG thresholds and general slave-flow control remain incomplete.

core_paths.current_qemu: Exact width/address conversion, the 0xffff-transfer maximum, flat DDR boundary crossing and non-destructive increment/decrement overlap traversal work. Unsafe overlap order is unspecified. Chunks are ignored and a complete buffer runs in one bottom half.
core_paths.evidence: RT-Thread d1.mem2mem passes 52,296 byte/canary checks over 24 width/address/chunk vectors; d1.channels passes 1,027 checks over all eight channels; d1.word-width-alias independently proves 11b is a four-byte transfer; d1.boundary-overlap passes 285,040 checks over a 0xffff-word transfer crossing 4 KiB/64 KiB/1 MiB, exact DDR-end completion and two 8 KiB safe overlaps. Focused qtests independently cover those paths plus global enable, both WORD encodings and HSMCI routes/migration.

core_paths.current_qemu: Fixed mode grants the lowest pending channel. Modified round-robin mode starts after the previous granted channel and migrates that cursor. This is exact for simultaneously pending one-transaction buffers; whole buffers still run in one bottom half, so independent source/destination and burst-boundary arbitration remain incomplete.
core_paths.evidence: RT-Thread d1.arbitration passes 139 register, ordering, overwrite, event and guard checks. A focused qtest seeds channel 0, migrates, proves channel 1 then channel 0 round-robin ordering, switches to fixed priority and proves channel 0 then channel 1 ordering.

core_paths.current_qemu: Walks a five-word list up to 1024 entries, masks link interface bits, accepts descriptors straddling a page boundary, loads future descriptors from live memory, honors source/destination descriptor-update-disable controls, implements descriptor-coupled AUTO rows 7/8, terminates Row 1 without following a stale next pointer, parks any reachable cyclic graph, implements stop-on-DONE and writes back zero BTSIZE plus DONE.
core_paths.evidence: RT-Thread d1.linked-list, d1.stop-on-done, d1.partial-descriptor-reload, d1.descriptor-auto-boundary and d1.live-descriptor-update pass 850 exact byte/live-register/writeback checks. Focused qtests independently verify those contracts plus tagged cross-page links, Row-1 disabled-next termination and deterministic parking/reuse for self and non-head tail cycles.
core_paths.rtthread_test: d1.linked-list, d1.stop-on-done, d1.partial-descriptor-reload, d1.descriptor-auto-boundary and d1.live-descriptor-update

core_paths.current_qemu: Maintains independent 10-bit source and destination transfer counters and replaces the ordinary address step with the programmed 16-bit hole at each boundary. Registers and partial row counters migrate.
core_paths.evidence: RT-Thread d1.picture-in-picture passes 141 register, data, hole, guard and completion checks. Focused qtests independently prove asymmetric source/destination holes and migration after one of four software-paced transfers, when both row counters are nonzero.

core_paths.current_qemu: For non-descriptor buffers, AUTO reloads BTSIZE and optionally source/destination addresses, yields between uninterrupted buffers, stalls at an unmasked BTC boundary and resumes through KEEPON. For descriptor-coupled rows 7/8, it replays the initial BTSIZE while loading the other CTRLA fields and the table-selected source or destination address from each LLI. Replay base state and a live stalled boundary migrate.
core_paths.evidence: RT-Thread d1.auto-replay passes 141 reload, state, data, guard and event checks; d1.descriptor-auto-boundary adds 166 checks for both descriptor-coupled AUTO rows and poisoned descriptor BTSIZE/address fields. Focused qtests verify both rows and migrate the non-descriptor stalled boundary through final KEEPON completion.

core_paths.current_qemu: Single and chunk requests pace source and destination software handshakes, honor SCSIZE/DCSIZE, update live residue/addresses and clear accepted request/LAST bits. Peripheral-flow-controller LAST terminates the buffer. Software-paced partial FIFO/request/suspend state is migrated.
core_paths.evidence: RT-Thread d1.software-requests (27 checks), d1.software-last (13) and d1.mixed-software-requests (141) pass; qtests cover request granularity, both destination/source arrival orders, requests queued before enable, LAST and a suspended partial-width request across migration.

core_paths.current_qemu: Address-space read/write and descriptor fetch/writeback failures stop the channel, preserve partial live state and set the channel ERR bit. Source and destination failures retain exact byte-level address/BTSIZE residue, a partial five-word descriptor fetch is atomic with respect to live channel state, and a completed buffer whose DONE writeback fails reports BTC plus ERR without false CBTC. Unaligned RAM is not classified as an expected error because the datasheet defines ERR through AHB read/write failures without requiring alignment aborts.
core_paths.evidence: RT-Thread d1.bus-error passes 150 checks for source and destination aborts, consumed-source-byte residue, atomic descriptor-fetch failure, no false BTC and channel reuse. Focused qtests additionally force source and destination failures after two successful bytes at DDR end, a rejected secure-pflash destination, byte reads and writes rejected by peripheral MMIO, and rejected descriptor DONE writeback; they prove exact data, address, BTSIZE and event residue without test-only model hooks.

core_paths.current_qemu: Suspension freezes an enabled channel before transfer, RES restores it, disable discards FIFO state, and the state migrates.
core_paths.evidence: RT-Thread d1.suspend-resume passes 10 state/data checks; qtests cover enable-plus-suspend and a suspended partial FIFO with queued CREQ across migration.

core_paths.current_qemu: BTC/CBTC/ERR status is masked into the level IRQ; late enable and disable take effect immediately, EBCISR read clears status, and post-load reconstructs a pending output level.
core_paths.evidence: RT-Thread d1.irq and d1.irq-mask pass 143 checks; focused qtests prove late enable/disable/read-clear and a pending enabled IRQ across migration.

request_routes.qemu_behavior: Per-word handshake gated by HSMCI_DMA.DMAEN (driver-set for DMA, cleared for CPU transfers): HSMCI drops and re-raises the request around every FIFO word, each edge grants one SCSIZE/DCSIZE chunk, and CHER samples the live level instead of banked edges. CHKSIZE/OFFSET are retained configuration (data is synchronously available). Descriptor shorter/longer than the card transaction stops with BTC plus in-progress card state, or waits with exact residue for CHDR; both boundaries and the DTOR MCK-cycle data timeout (access-restarted, raising read-to-clear DTOE) migrate exactly. Beat granularity inside a chunk is not yet modelled.
